extraction.text:
SHATANAND M P

Bengaluru, India · 7996598520, smp0598@outlook.com

Senior Fund Accounting professional with 5+ years of experience in Luxembourg fund accounting, NAV production, reconciliations, trade lifecycle, fund launches, and client servicing. Managed 40+ clients and $200B+ AUM while maintaining 99% accuracy and timeliness across complex investment structures and asset classes.

EXPERIENCE

JULY 2024 – PRESENT SENIOR ANALYST: LUX FUND ACCOUNTING, NORTHERN TRUST

Onboarded 15+ clients to the team, responsible for handling 80+ new fund launches over the last 3 years.

Ensured timely delivery of NAV at accurate prices to the client with 99% accuracy and timeliness.

Calculated and delivered NAVs for 100+ Luxembourg funds with 99% on-time delivery and pricing accuracy, managing 40+ clients with AUM of more than USD 200B.

Managed valuation and accounting for diverse asset classes including equities, fixed income, hedge funds, derivatives, private equity, CFDs, and alternative investments. • Successfully reconciled NAV units for subscription and redemption, ensuring seamless transactions for investors.

Proactively resolved 10K+ breaks monthly relating to cash, position, currency contracts, futures, corporate action breaks, and cash posting with custodians and prime brokers to support NAV valuation and reporting.

Provided on-the-job training to 50+ team members over the course of 5+ years and supported them in understanding their responsibilities.

Conducted proficiency and process training for 20+ new joiners, accelerating onboarding



and improving operational readiness. Independently managed critical NAV deliverables while collaborating with cross-functional teams to resolve complex exceptions and meet reporting deadlines.

APRIL 2022 – JUNE 2024 ANALYST: LUX FUND ACCOUNTING, NORTHERN TRUST

Calculated and delivered NAVs for 20+ Luxembourg funds with 99% on-time delivery and pricing accuracy.

Successfully reconciled NAV units for subscription and redemption, ensuring seamless transactions for investors

Proactively resolved cash, position, currency contracts, and cash posting with custodians. • Managed valuation and accounting for diverse asset classes including: bonds, equity, mutual funds, hedge funds and futures

Successfully supported the launch of 2 clients and 10+ fund accounts over a 2-year period.

JAN 2021 – MAR 2022 PROCESS EXECUTIVE: RECONCILIATION INFOSYS BPM LTD

Performed booking and reconciliation of 2K+ monthly cash breaks. • Processing statements and payment requests on the FIS application 50+ daily. • Ensured reconciliation at the accuracy and timeliness 99.9%. • Provided on-the-job training to 20 new team members.

EDUCATION

JULY 2017 – NOV 2020 BACHELOR OF COMMERCE, MES INSTITUTE OF MANAGEMENT SPECIALIZATION – ACCOUNTING AND TAXATION CGPA – 8.3

FUND ACCOUNTING PLATFORMS

FIS Enterprise Software • Fund Master • TLM Premium Application

DSM and ERM Application • FTS /IDC Application • Advanced MS Excel

OPERATIONS

Cash and position reconciliation • FX reconciliation • Fund Launches

PB reconciliations • CA reconciliations

KEY ACHIEVEMENTS

Managed 40+ clients and $200B+ AUM. • Delivered NAVs for 100+ Luxembourg funds with 99% accuracy. • Supported 80+ fund launches. • Resolved 10,000+ reconciliation breaks monthly. • Trained 50+ analysts and conducted proficiency sessions for 20+ new joiners.
